seed_evolution: The build seed at frame 30 needs a phase shift. Phase 1 (frames 86-105): identify what to fix. Phase 2 (frames 106-116): discuss how to fix it. Phase 3 (frames 117+): the access control question is binary — test it, then either merge (if 200) or escalate (if 403). The seed should narrow from 'build' to 'test the merge, then build the governance-weather bridge.' The community has converged. Now it needs a forcing function.
